say:3:1331113702:1.text: Oh, Dura... How could such a joyful celebration be nothing but an illusion?!

say:4:1331113703:1.text: No wonder I felt like I was constantly going in and out of the temple... Turns out, my suspicion was right...

say:5:1331113704:1.text: So, does this mean I have finally broken free of the illusion?
